title: Jammu & Kashmir High Court seeks amicus report on Dal lake PIL pending since 2002
description: The Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh High Court has sought a report on the progress made in a 2002 Public Interest Litigation (PIL) petition concerning the preservation and conservation of Dal Lake [Syed Iqbal Tahir Geelani V/s State of J&K]A Division Bench of Acting Chief Justice Sanjeev Kumar and Justice Mohd Yousuf Wani observed that the PIL was pending for the last 24 years, during which multiple orders were passed to improve the condition of the lake. It thus sought a "brief factual note"
